parsed.note_claim: The photo does not show Queen Elizabeth & Prince Philip bowing for Haile Selassie I, but unidentified guests at an event years before the British Royal family visited Ethiopia.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Both photos were taken by Alfred Eisenstaedt in 1955 for the LIFE Magazine. ... Queen Elizabet II made a state visit to Ethiopia in 1965. ... Queen Elizabeth II simply cannot be in those two photos, because they were not visiting Ethiopia in 1955.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms the photos were taken in 1955 at Haile Selassie's silver jubilee, that the people in them are unidentified (likely diplomatic corps members), and that Queen Elizabeth II did not visit Ethiopia until 1965, substantiating the note's claims.
